sections.heading: RESISTING ARREST
sections.text: (1)Any person who wilfully evades law enforcement on foot, or a person with the authority to execute the law as prescribed by the Law of the Land, in an attempt to resist penalization or punishment for offenses committed, or in an attempt to evade detainment and arrest, shall be guilty of Resisting Arrest. (2)Resisting arrest shall be a Class E offence.

sections.heading: RESISTING ARREST WITH A DEADLY WEAPON
sections.text: (1)Any person that uses force to resist lawful arrest using a weapon of lethal force such as an automatic gun or any other lethal firearm with the ability to kill an individual and if a person intentionally prevents or obstructs a law enforcement official or a person acting in a law enforcement official’s presence and at their direction from conducting an arrest, search, or transportation of the actor or another by using lethal force against the law enforcement official or another, shall be guilty of Resisting Arrest with a deadly weapon. (2)This shall be a Class D Offense.

sections.heading: MANUAL EVASION
sections.text:
(1)Any person who flees the scene of a crime or evades any law enforcement official by foot, without the use of any motor
vehicle or aircraft after failing to comply with any and all visual, verbal, sonic signs or clearly interpretable actions or signals by an Officer, shall be guilty of Manual Evasion. (2)This shall be a Class F Offense.

sections.heading: FAILURE TO COMPLY
sections.text: (1)Any person who refuses to obey a lawful order issued by a peace officer, in the commission of their duties as prescribed by law and permitted under the Constitution and law of the land, shall be guilty of Failure to Comply. (2)This shall be a Class G Offense.

sections.heading: IMPERSONATION
sections.text: (1)Any person who establishes oneself as something that the person is not, in a blatantly negligent or malicious manner, shall be guilty of impersonation. (2)This shall be a Class F offence. (3)Subjects shall only be penalized for impersonating persons employed within the federal government or the municipal government. (4)Persons may also be subject to subsection (1) if they create or distribute any material under the name or entity of a person or organization that the person does not belong to, or otherwise have the legal authority to represent the subject in such material, with the intent of spreading harmful and incorrect falsehoods or for the purposes of engaging in fraudulent behavior.

sections.heading: UNLAWFUL ESCAPE AND RESCUE
sections.text: (1)Any person who leaves a correctional facility, as a subject that is incarcerated, without legal authorization to do so shall be guilty of escape. (2)Any person who aids or assists the escape of an incarcerated person, whether by monetary means, vehicular or verbal means, without legal authorization, shall be guilty of rescue. (3)Attempting to leave a correctional facility without authorization while incarcerated at that facility shall also be the act of escape. (4)These shall be Class F Offenses. (5)Only officials permitted in law may authorize subjects to be removed or transferred from correctional facilities and such authorizations may only occur when the subject has a sentence commuted, or such a release is ordered by a judge for other circumstances, as prescribed by law.

sections.heading: OBSTRUCTION OF COMMERCE
sections.text: (1)Any person who intentionally obstructs the legal operation of any towing official under the Department of Transportation or any towing company approved by the Department of Commerce and Labor or any transportation service under the Department of Transportation or other company approved by the Department of Commerce and Labor, when operating in a legal fashion, shall be guilty of obstructing commerce. (2)This shall be a Class F Offense.

sections.heading: BRANDISHING ARMS
sections.text: (1)Any person who brandishes a lethal firearm when they are not in imminent danger when in a public area or federal property and/or without legal basis to do so, shall be guilty of brandishing arms. (2)This shall be a Class G Offense.

sections.heading: POSSESSION OF OFFENSIVE WEAPONRY
sections.text: Offense Class F (1)Any person who possesses a firearm or lethal weapon that is specified by law to be illegal or purchased from a dealer within the map instead of via a business, shop or the gun store, shall be guilty of possession of unlawful instruments and weapons. (2)Possession of unlawful instruments and weapons shall also be the act of possessing an item which is outlawed and deemed criminal by existing law. (3)This shall be a Class F Offense.

sections.heading: OBSTRUCTION OF A CRIMINAL INVESTIGATION
sections.text: (1)Any person who wilfully, by means of bribery, extortion and other means to obstruct, delay, or prevent the communication of information relating to a violation of any criminal statute by any person to a criminal investigator or Department of Justice attorney, shall be guilty of Obstruction of criminal investigation. (2)This shall be a Class C Offense.

sections.heading: JURISDICTIONAL ABSCONDING
sections.text:
(1)Any person who wilfully absconds an ongoing legal process in contravention to a lawful order or writ compelling their attendance, shall be guilty of Jurisdictional absconding.
(2)Any person who obstructs the proceeds of justice by leaving the ROBLOX group or USAR discord or Court discord to avoid possible criminal or civil liability instead of enduring the legal processes afforded by the Constitution and law, shall be guilty of Jurisdictional absconding. (3)This shall be a Class A Offense. (4)The statute of limitations on an offense shall be frozen from the date the absconder leaves the ROBLOX group to the day they rejoin.
